scope: Read-only public chain/provider research. No intended user wallet, credentials, signed bytes, approval, broadcast or application configuration change.

method.screen: Chain 56 and historical native balance plus USDT balanceOf at latest minus 200000 blocks; HTTPS only, skip credential-shaped/query and WebSocket URLs.
method.deepVerification: Three canonical blocks including 40000000 (2024-06-28), nonzero native WBNB backing and USDT/WBNB pool balances, historical nonce, two receipt dates, full transaction blocks, canonical receipt fields and normalized log digests.
method.coreCriteria: Historical state, full transaction blocks, canonical receipts, existing readers. Standalone eth_getLogs is additional capability, not required by current receipt-effect reader.
method.privacy: Public pool/contract balances and sampled transaction hashes only. Sample sender used transiently to exercise receipt identity; no sender, recipient or full event payload retained.
method.probeCorrection: Initial deeper probe used Blast for reference log discovery and received a rate limit. Switched research discovery to Sentio and reran paced verification; no app code change.
